# Evidence Contract edge cases

196 cases, 127 of them negative (must fail: an invalid
contract, a breaking diff, or inputs a diff refuses). Generated by
`scripts/generate_contract_cases.py`; run by `tests/test_contract_cases.py`. Do not edit by hand.

| id | kind | expected outcome | rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `validate-ok-minimal` | validate | valid | the smallest valid contract: id, version and one requirement |
| `validate-ok-base` | validate | valid | the base contract every diff case starts from validates |
| `validate-ok-native-base` | validate | valid | the native-shape base contract validates |
| `validate-ok-profile-outcome-generic` | validate | valid | outcome in the abstract shape needs only id, profile and statement |
| `validate-ok-profile-obligation-generic` | validate | valid | obligation in the abstract shape needs a clause_ref |
| `validate-ok-profile-process` | validate | valid | process stub needs only id, profile and statement |
| `validate-ok-profile-quality` | validate | valid | quality stub needs only id, profile and statement |

| `validate-ok-profile-settlement` | validate | valid | settlement carries only a ref at the root |
| `validate-ok-native-without-profile` | validate | valid | the native shape treats profile as optional (an outcome by default) |
| `validate-ok-mixed-profiles` | validate | valid | one contract may mix all seven profiles across its requirements |
| `validate-ok-all-epistemic-types` | validate | valid | all eight epistemic types may be accepted at once |

| `validate-ok-principal-nostr` | validate | valid | a principal_ref is scheme:value; the scheme is profile-defined |
| `validate-ok-principal-authority-context` | validate | valid | authority_context is a free list of citations, not a grant |
| `validate-ok-process-extra-field` | validate | valid | the process stub stays open to extension: an unknown field is accepted |
| `validate-ok-quality-free-fields` | validate | valid | quality's sketched fields accept any value |
| `validate-ok-human-role-blocks` | validate | valid | human_role review/override/escalation are open objects |
| `validate-ok-unicode-statement` | validate | valid | statements may be any non-empty Unicode text |
| `validate-ok-unicode-requirement-id` | validate | valid | requirement ids are any non-empty string |
| `validate-ok-non-numeric-version` | validate | valid | version is an opaque label, not a number |
| `validate-ok-no-subject` | validate | valid | subject is optional |
| `validate-ok-window-null-cure-grace` | validate | valid | a window's cure and grace may be null |
| `validate-ok-clause-all-fields` | validate | valid | a clause may carry every optional field |
| `validate-ok-consequence-settlement` | validate | valid | consequence.class settlement carries only a reference at the root |
| `validate-ok-adjudication-hybrid` | validate | valid | adjudication mode hybrid with a policy reference |
| `validate-ok-uncertainty-escalate` | validate | valid | uncertainty may escalate on both missing and conflicting evidence |
| `validate-ok-native-tool-call-instrument` | validate | valid | a native requirement may name a tool call as its instrument |
| `validate-ok-native-refused` | validate | valid | a refused requirement states why it cannot be measured |

| `validate-ok-fifty-requirements` | validate | valid | a contract may carry many requirements |
| `validate-ok-duplicate-requirement-ids` | validate | valid | the schema does not enforce unique requirement ids (contract diff does) |
| `validate-ok-obligation-refs-on-outcome` | validate | valid | an outcome may cite the obligations it is traced to |
| `validate-ok-temporal-and-disclosure` | validate | valid | temporal.reversal_window and disclosure.policy_ref are optional references |
| `validate-bad-missing-id` | validate | invalid: required at <root> | a contract without an id cannot be referenced by a Result |
| `validate-bad-missing-version` | validate | invalid: required at <root> | a contract without a version cannot be pinned |

| `validate-bad-unknown-epistemic-type` | validate | invalid: enum at requirements/0/evidence_requirements/accepted_epistemic_types/0 | epistemic types are a closed set of eight |

| `validate-bad-principal-uppercase-scheme` | validate | invalid: pattern at principal/principal_ref | a principal_ref scheme is lower-case |

| `validate-bad-native-unknown-forward-verdict` | validate | invalid: enum at requirements/0/forward_verdict | forward_verdict is closed |

| `diff-identical` | diff | identical | a contract diffed against itself has no changes |
| `diff-key-order-only` | diff | identical | member order is not content: same JCS bytes, no changes |
| `diff-version-bump-only` | diff | non-breaking | a new version label with no other change is non-breaking |
| `diff-version-reused` | diff | breaking | one version label must never name two different contracts |
| `diff-contract-id-changed` | diff | breaking | claims name their contract by id; a new id is a different contract |
| `diff-requirement-added` | diff | breaking | a new requirement owes new evidence |
| `diff-requirement-removed` | diff | breaking | a claim against A that cites a removed requirement no longer resolves in B |
| `diff-requirement-reid` | diff | breaking | re-identifying a requirement orphans every claim that cites the old id |
| `diff-requirement-reid-with-change` | diff | breaking | a new id with different content is a removal plus an addition |
| `diff-requirements-reordered` | diff | non-breaking | requirements are keyed by id; order carries no meaning |
| `diff-statement-deterministic` | diff | non-breaking | rewording a deterministically evaluated requirement is editorial |
| `diff-statement-process` | diff | breaking | a process requirement with no deterministic adjudication may be judged on its wording |
| `diff-statement-semantic` | diff | breaking | under semantic adjudication the statement is what is judged |
| `diff-statement-becomes-judged` | diff | breaking | a statement reworded while adjudication moves off deterministic is breaking twice |
| `diff-epistemic-narrowed` | diff | breaking | accepting fewer epistemic types tightens the requirement |
| `diff-epistemic-widened` | diff | non-breaking | accepting more epistemic types loosens the requirement |
| `diff-epistemic-swapped` | diff | breaking | swapping an accepted type may orphan evidence of the old type |
| `diff-epistemic-reordered` | diff | non-breaking | accepted types are a set: reordering them is no change |
| `diff-epistemic-dropped` | diff | non-breaking | dropping the accepted list accepts every type |
| `diff-epistemic-introduced` | diff | breaking | introducing an accepted list where there was none restricts types |
| `diff-source-added` | diff | breaking | requiring one more source tightens the requirement |
| `diff-source-removed` | diff | non-breaking | requiring fewer sources loosens the requirement |
| `diff-source-changed` | diff | breaking | replacing a source is breaking: evidence from the old source no longer counts |
| `diff-source-list-dropped` | diff | non-breaking | dropping required_sources entirely requires no particular source |
| `diff-assurance-raised` | diff | breaking | a higher assurance floor tightens the requirement |
| `diff-assurance-lowered` | diff | non-breaking | a lower assurance floor loosens the requirement |
| `diff-assurance-same-floor` | diff | breaking | a multi-grade list is undefined, so changing its members at the same floor is breaking |
| `diff-assurance-unknown-grade` | diff | breaking | a grade off the ladder has no direction: breaking |
| `diff-assurance-introduced` | diff | breaking | introducing an assurance floor where there was none tightens |
| `diff-freshness-shortened` | diff | breaking | evidence must be newer: tightened |
| `diff-freshness-lengthened` | diff | non-breaking | older evidence now counts: loosened |
| `diff-freshness-respelled` | diff | non-breaking | P7D and P1W are the same length: editorial |
| `diff-freshness-time-units` | diff | breaking | durations compare by length across units: PT167H is an hour short of P7D |
| `diff-freshness-unparseable` | diff | breaking | a freshness that is not an ISO-8601 duration has no direction |
| `diff-freshness-overlong-component` | diff | breaking | a duration component over nine digits does not parse, so has no direction |
| `diff-freshness-dangling-t` | diff | breaking | a time designator with no time component is not a duration |
| `diff-freshness-month-vs-days` | diff | breaking | a month is not a fixed number of days: P1M to P30D is not comparable |
| `diff-freshness-month-vs-one-day` | diff | breaking | months and days are never ordered against each other, even when obvious |
| `diff-freshness-year-as-months` | diff | non-breaking | a year is exactly twelve months: P1Y to P12M is a respelling |
| `diff-freshness-months-lengthened` | diff | non-breaking | months compare with months: P1M to P2M is longer |
| `diff-freshness-month-plus-hours` | diff | non-breaking | same months and more hours is longer in one part and equal in the other |
| `diff-freshness-mixed-opposite` | diff | breaking | longer in months but shorter in days cannot be ordered |
| `diff-freshness-month-from-unbounded` | diff | breaking | any limit where there was none tightens, months included |
| `diff-native-window-days-to-month` | diff | breaking | a window in days replaced by one in months is not comparable |
| `diff-freshness-dropped` | diff | non-breaking | no freshness limit at all is the loosest |
| `diff-independence-changed` | diff | breaking | independence is an opaque predicate: any change is breaking |
| `diff-coverage-changed` | diff | breaking | coverage is an opaque predicate: any change is breaking |
| `diff-adjudication-mode` | diff | breaking | a different adjudication mode evaluates differently |
| `diff-uncertainty-on-missing` | diff | breaking | how missing evidence resolves changes every gap |
| `diff-approval-added` | diff | breaking | one more approval owed tightens |
| `diff-approval-removed` | diff | non-breaking | fewer approvals owed loosens |
| `diff-sequence-step-added` | diff | breaking | one more required step tightens |
| `diff-sequence-step-removed` | diff | non-breaking | dropping a required step loosens |
| `diff-sequence-reordered` | diff | breaking | reordering required steps is neither tighter nor looser |
| `diff-escalation-path` | diff | non-breaking | where an escalation goes is not read when sufficiency is decided |
| `diff-process-extension-field` | diff | breaking | an extension field on an open stub has no rule: breaking |
| `diff-profile-changed` | diff | breaking | a different profile is a different kind of requirement |
| `diff-clause-ref-changed` | diff | breaking | citing a different clause changes which obligation is evidenced |
| `diff-obligation-refs-added` | diff | breaking | the obligation trace changes what a result is cited for |
| `diff-population-changed` | diff | breaking | a different population selector evaluates different jobs |
| `diff-consequence-class` | diff | breaking | a different consequence class changes what a result triggers |
| `diff-evaluation-period` | diff | breaking | a different evaluation period is a different window of evidence |
| `diff-principal-added` | diff | breaking | naming a principal where none was named changes who the contract is about |
| `diff-native-window-shortened` | diff | breaking | a shorter window tightens |
| `diff-native-window-lengthened` | diff | non-breaking | a longer window loosens |
| `diff-native-cure-added` | diff | non-breaking | a cure period where there was none loosens |
| `diff-native-grace-dropped-to-null` | diff | breaking | null grace is zero grace: removing a grace period tightens |
| `diff-native-window-removed` | diff | non-breaking | no window at all is the loosest |
| `diff-native-window-added` | diff | breaking | a window where there was none tightens |
| `diff-native-tier-raised` | diff | breaking | informational to must_have now gates the result |
| `diff-native-tier-defaulted` | diff | non-breaking | an explicit informational tier and an absent tier are the same |
| `diff-native-tier-lowered` | diff | non-breaking | must_have to absent (informational) no longer gates the result |
| `diff-native-grade-raised` | diff | breaking | a higher required grade tightens |
| `diff-native-evidence-rule` | diff | breaking | the evidence rule is the predicate: any change is breaking |
| `diff-native-statement-deterministic` | diff | non-breaking | a deterministic native requirement may be reworded |
| `diff-native-statement-manual` | diff | breaking | a manually checked requirement is checked against its wording |
| `diff-native-statement-judged-mode` | diff | breaking | a judged-mode requirement is judged against its wording |
| `diff-native-forward-verdict` | diff | breaking | a different forward verdict is a different evaluation |
| `diff-clause-source-url` | diff | non-breaking | where the clause text is published is not read when sufficiency is decided |
| `diff-clause-article` | diff | breaking | a different article is a different obligation |
| `diff-mixed-tighten-and-loosen` | diff | breaking | one tightening makes the whole diff breaking, however much else loosens |
| `diff-all-non-breaking` | diff | non-breaking | loosenings and editorial changes together stay non-breaking |
| `diff-requirement-removed-among-loosenings` | diff | breaking | one removed requirement makes an otherwise loosening diff breaking |
| `diff-ext-window-extra-field` | diff | breaking | an unknown member inside an extension window is still a change, not dropped |
| `diff-ext-window-string` | diff | breaking | an extension window that is not an object has no rule: breaking, never a crash |
| `diff-ext-window-shortened` | diff | breaking | the window rule is the native shape's; on quality a shorter window is just a change |
| `diff-ext-source-url` | diff | breaking | source_url is editorial only inside a native clause, not as an extension field |
| `diff-ext-tier` | diff | breaking | tier is ranked only on the native shape; an extension tier has no direction |
| `diff-ext-escalation-path-on-human-role` | diff | breaking | escalation_path is editorial on process, not as a human_role extension |
| `diff-ext-evidence-requirements-on-quality` | diff | breaking | quality defines no evidence_requirements; its freshness has no rule |
| `diff-ext-adjudication-on-process` | diff | breaking | an extension adjudication cannot make a process statement editorial |
| `diff-process-sequence-rule-still-applies` | diff | non-breaking | on process, required_sequence is defined and keeps its rule |
| `diff-shape-changed-generic-to-native` | diff | breaking | moving a requirement between shapes compares fields with no rule |
| `diff-bad-a-invalid` | diff | error: invalid_contract | an invalid contract is refused before any diffing |
| `diff-bad-b-invalid` | diff | error: invalid_contract | both sides are validated, not just the first |
| `diff-bad-b-uppercase-epistemic-type` | diff | error: invalid_contract | an upper-case epistemic type is not the lower-case one: the contract is refused, not diffed |
| `diff-bad-duplicate-requirement-id` | diff | error: duplicate_requirement_id | two requirements with one id cannot be matched to claims |
| `diff-bad-b-self-declared-status` | diff | error: invalid_contract | a contract that self-declares a status is refused, not diffed |
| `diff-bad-approvals-not-a-list` | diff | error: invalid_contract | approvals turned from a list into a string is refused, never 'loosened' |
| `diff-bad-required-sources-not-a-list` | diff | error: invalid_contract | required_sources as a string is refused, never 'loosened' |
| `diff-bad-epistemic-types-not-a-list` | diff | error: invalid_contract | accepted types as a string is refused, never ranked |
| `diff-bad-sequence-not-a-list` | diff | error: invalid_contract | a required sequence as a string is refused, never ranked |
| `diff-bad-escalation-path-null` | diff | error: invalid_contract | a null escalation path is refused; unvalidated it is a change, not editorial |
| `diff-bad-assurance-not-a-list` | diff | error: invalid_contract | a minimum assurance that is a number is refused, never ranked |
| `diff-bad-native-tier-not-a-string` | diff | error: invalid_contract | a tier that is a list is refused; unvalidated it is a change, never a crash |
| `diff-bad-unknown-epistemic-type-added` | diff | error: invalid_contract | adding a type outside the closed set is refused, not 'loosened' |
| `pin-base` | pin | digest | a Result names the base contract by reference and JCS digest |
| `pin-base-key-order` | pin | digest | member order does not change the digest (same value as pin-base) |
| `pin-version-2` | pin | digest | a new version label changes the digest |
| `pin-unicode` | pin | digest | non-ASCII text is digested as UTF-8 per JCS |
| `pin-escapes` | pin | digest | control characters and quotes use JCS escapes |
| `pin-native-nulls` | pin | digest | explicit nulls are digested, not dropped |
